numeric_expression: height_m = by_type(townhouse: max(13.0 m; overlay(HT)); apartment_building: max(19.0 m; overlay(HT))) @(1)(D)

calculation_handling.description: On a lot abutting a major street, a townhouse may reach the greater of 13.0 m or HT, and an apartment building the greater of 19.0 m or HT.
calculation_handling.gaps: The townhouse arm comes from (1)(D)(i) and the apartment arm from (1)(D)(ii); cited at the unit path (1)(D). Requires knowing whether the lot abuts a major street, which may not be held for every lot.

calculation_handling.description: Rooftop equipment on the tower portion of a building may exceed the maximum height by 6.5 m if it covers no more than 450 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 6.5 m projection allowance has no DSL target (rooftop equipment height) and 450 m2 is a roof-equipment area threshold with no DSL input; both recorded as threshold_used_in_application as the closest closed reason. Towers (storeys above 24.0 m) are outside MaxBLD building types.

calculation_handling.description: Chimneys, pipes and vents on a tower roof may exceed the (10)(A) allowance by a further 3.0 m.
calculation_handling.gaps: The 3.0 m further projection has no DSL target; recorded as threshold_used_in_application as the closest closed reason.

calculation_handling.description: Defines a tower for 10.10.40.10(10): portions enclosing storeys above 24.0 m, with average storey GFA above 24.0 m of no more than 750 m2.
calculation_handling.gaps: The defined term "tower" is not a DSL variable; target none.

numeric_expression: height_storeys = by_type(townhouse: max(4 storeys; overlay(ST)); apartment_building: max(6 storeys; overlay(ST))) @(3)(D)

calculation_handling.description: On a lot abutting a major street, a townhouse may have the greater of 4 storeys or ST, and an apartment building the greater of 6 storeys or ST (excluding a mechanical penthouse).
calculation_handling.gaps: The text writes the numbers as words ("four storeys", "six storeys"); normalized to numerals 4 and 6. Arms come from (3)(D)(i) and (ii). Mechanical penthouse exclusion not expressed. Requires major street status of the lot.

calculation_handling.description: A roof above the second storey on a detached house may not be steeper than 5 vertical to 3 horizontal.
calculation_handling.gaps: Roof slope is not a DSL target; the 5.0/3.0 slope ratio recorded as threshold_used_in_application (closest closed reason).

units.disclosure: Detached houses in the R zone cannot have a roof steeper than 5:3 above the second storey; we do not check roof design.

calculation_handling.description: Dormer walls are not main walls if the dormer face is in a roof directly above a main wall within the main wall height limit (and (B) is met).
calculation_handling.gaps: "a residential building with two or more storeys": building_types left any because no specific type is named; "two" recorded as a threshold literal.

calculation_handling.description: Dormer walls are not main walls if total dormer face width is no more than 40% of the width of the qualifying main walls.
calculation_handling.gaps: Could be read as LIMIT element_width_pct max 40 pct; kept DEFINE because the clause decides whether dormer walls count as main walls rather than prohibiting wider dormers.

calculation_handling.description: The lowest point of a main pedestrian entrance through the front or a side main wall of a detached or semi-detached house may be no higher than 1.2 m above established grade.
calculation_handling.gaps: none

calculation_handling.description: Floor levels of a rear addition may not be higher than the uppermost floor level of the existing building.
calculation_handling.gaps: Relative to existing building floor levels; no DSL target. "residential building" names no specific type, so building_types any.

units.disclosure: A rear addition to a house cannot have floors higher than the top floor of the existing house; we do not check this because it depends on the existing building.

10.10.40.10(1).explanation: In the R zone the maximum building height is the HT number on the Height Overlay Map, or 10.0 m where no HT number is shown. A houseplex may always reach at least 10.0 m, and on a major street a townhouse may reach at least 13.0 m and an apartment building at least 19.0 m.

10.10.40.10(10).explanation: On tall towers (storeys above 24.0 m), rooftop mechanical equipment may rise up to 6.5 m above the height limit if it covers no more than 450 m2, and chimneys, pipes and vents a further 3.0 m.

10.10.40.10(11).explanation: For a flat or shallow-roofed house (not an apartment building), extra main wall height is allowed above the normal main wall limit if the upper front and rear walls are set back at least 1.4 m.

10.10.40.10(12).explanation: Repeats regulation (11): for a flat or shallow-roofed house, extra main wall height is allowed if the upper front and rear walls are set back at least 1.4 m.

10.10.40.10(2).explanation: The main walls of a house (not an apartment building) may be no taller than the higher of 7.0 m or 2.5 m below the building height limit, applied either to the side walls or to the front and rear walls; townhouses on a major street are exempt.

10.10.40.10(3).explanation: The maximum number of storeys is the ST number on the Height Overlay Map; with no ST number the storeys are not limited. Houseplexes are exempt, and on a major street townhouses may have at least 4 storeys and apartment buildings at least 6.

10.10.40.10(4).explanation: On a detached house, a roof above the second storey cannot be steeper than 5 units up for every 3 across.

10.10.40.10(5).explanation: Dormer walls do not count as main walls if the dormers sit above main walls within the height limit and are no wider in total than 40% of those walls.

10.10.40.10(6).explanation: For a detached or semi-detached house, the main front or side entrance can be no more than 1.2 m above the ground.

10.10.40.10(7).explanation: A rear addition cannot have floors higher than the top floor of the house it is added to.

10.10.40.10(8).explanation: On buildings taller than 15.0 m, antennae, flagpoles and satellite dishes on the roof may extend up to 5.0 m above the height limit.
